youthful.en: OK, let’s recap the new vocabulary we’ve learned about staying young at heart, an idiom which means to think and behave in a youthful way, in spite of growing older.
youthful.zh: 好的，让我们回顾一下我们学到的关于保持心态年轻（young at heart）的新词汇，这个习语的意思是尽管变老，但思想和行为依然年轻。

youthful.en: In this programme, we’ll be hearing about some new research offering fresh advice on how to stay young at heart, an idiom meaning to keep a youthful outlook on life, whatever your age.
youthful.zh: 在这个节目中，我们将听到一些新的研究，它们为如何保持心态年轻（young at heart）——一个无论你多大年龄都保持对生活年轻看法的习语——提供了新鲜的建议。

youth.en: And he creates a youth militia. He calls them the Moissy.
youth.zh: 他还创建了一支青年民兵组织，称他们为“Moissy”。

youth.en: Plutarch wrote; “The ship wherein Theseus and the youth of Athens returned from Crete, had 30 oars, and was preserved by the Athenians.
youth.zh: 普鲁塔克写道：“忒修斯和雅典青年从克里特岛返回的那艘船有30支桨，被雅典人保存了下来。

youth.en: By promoting this radical vision, he positioned himself as the moderniser and the champion of Saudi youth, earning huge popular support.
youth.zh: 通过推行这一激进的愿景，他将自己塑造成为现代化主义者和沙特青年的拥护者，赢得了巨大的民众支持。

youth.en: While secularists and youth rallied in Tahrir Square with passion but little structure, the Brotherhood had members, money, and a plan.
youth.zh: 当世俗主义者和青年们带着激情却缺乏结构在解放广场集会时，兄弟会有成员、有资金、有计划。

youth.en: Meanwhile, political groups that had been crushed under Mubarak, from secular activists to youth movements, trade unions to fledgling political parties, they all scrambled to organise, sensing their opportunity.
youth.zh: 与此同时，在 Mubarak 统治下遭到打压的政治组织，从世俗活动人士到青年运动、工会到羽翼未丰的政党，都敏锐地嗅到了机会，争先恐后地组织起来。
